One of `disabled`, `private`, `enabled` or `public`. `private` will make the package registry accessible only to project members (reporter role and above). `enabled` will make the package registry accessible to everyone who has access to the project. `public` will make the package registry accessible to everyone. `disabled` will disable the package registry
